commands.purpose: All density tests including repair, receipt and producer tests
Profile fixed and matched arms with no-update and post-update controls
Run zero-grad, boundary-routed measured-cost pilot with charged out-of-tolerance control
Derive coherent receipts and a manifest from measured JSON
Updated X6 and X10 independent edge reproductions

required_results: non-integer/bool exposure values are refused with exact int type checks
cost pilot constructs DensityProducerBoundary before profiling
SELECTION_EPSILON is frozen in the validated protocol and used by selection
declared timing synchronization is executable; CPU is explicitly cpu_synchronous
root/repair01/repair02 are marked noncanonical without changing their receipt bytes
CURRENT.json points to repair03 with file hashes
out-of-tolerance control cost is charged to all and comparison total
control/feature-contract booleans are enforced by receipt generation
receipt writes are atomic, leave no final path on failure and permit retry
no native launch, scored labels, P update or capability claim
